uppartners-havocai:ashbyhq:94b2be79-eb3b.title: Mechanical Engineer
uppartners-havocai:ashbyhq:94b2be79-eb3b.descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Collaborative autonomy is how self-tasking teams of machines will solve hard human problems, and HavocAI is an unquestioned leader in collaborative autonomy. We set the standard for autonomous surface vessels for a wide range of defense and commercial maritime missions. Success requires us to grow quickly, and we’re looking for teammates who are passionate about solving hard problems, about pushing the envelope, and about preventing conflict and saving lives. Ambition is welcome to apply within.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. This role has a strong mechanical engineering focus, with exposure to electrical systems primarily from an integration and interface perspective. The position supports new system development, payload integration, and subsystem design for uncrewed surface vessels, working closely with electrical and software engineers to ensure robust, manufacturable, and field-ready hardware solutions.

The ideal candidate is highly proficient in mechanical design and CAD, experienced in bringing complex mechanical systems from concept through production, and comfortable collaborating with electrical engineers to define interfaces, routing, and packaging—without being the primary electrical designer.

 

Key Responsibilities and Requirements:

  • System Development & Architecture
    Lead and contribute to the mechanical design and integration of new systems and payloads, including structural components, enclosures, mounts, and overall system packaging. Support electrical integration by defining mechanical interfaces, routing paths, and mounting solutions.

  • Mechanical Design
    Create detailed CAD models, assemblies, and engineering drawings using SolidWorks for mechanical structures, housings, brackets, mounts, and mechanisms suitable for marine operating environments.

  • Electrical Interface Support
    Work alongside electrical engineers to support integration of wiring harnesses, connectors, and electronic subsystems. Interpret electrical schematics as needed and assist with mechanical aspects of cable routing, strain relief, connector mounting, and environmental protection.

  • Integration & Testing
    Participate in hardware builds, subsystem and bench testing, vehicle integration, and troubleshooting to validate mechanical designs and ensure reliable performance in operational conditions.

  • Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration
    Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and software engineers to specify, design, build, test, and integrate mechanically driven subsystems and electromechanical components (e.g., actuators, motors, power distribution hardware) into vehicles.

  • Documentation
    Produce and maintain accurate mechanical documentation including CAD drawings, bills of materials, interface control documentation (ICDs), test results, and configuration management records.

  • Manufacturing & Production Support
    Partner with technicians and manufacturing teams to ensure designs are manufacturable, cost-effective, serviceable, and appropriate for rugged, marine environments.

 

Qualifications:

  • 4-7 years of experience in mechanical engineering design and system integration.

  • Strong proficiency in SolidWorks for mechanical CAD modeling and drafting.

  • Solid understanding of mechanical systems, materials, tolerances, and structural design.

  • Working familiarity with electrical systems sufficient to support integration (e.g., connectors, harness routing, grounding, environmental sealing).

  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting mechanical and electromechanical systems.

  • Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams and integrating subsystems into complete platforms.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.

  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a Secret Security Clearance.

 

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with payload integration for uncrewed vehicle systems, particularly maritime or aerospace platforms.

  • Familiarity with mechanical aspects of wiring harness routing, connectorization and enclosure design.

  • Knowledge of thermal management, sealing, vibration, and shock considerations for embedded hardware.

  • Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM) and ruggedized or marine systems.

  • Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and field-support mindset.

  • Experience with additive manufacturing

 

Location:

  • Must be able to work from our North Kingstown (Quonset Point) RI office onsite 3+ days per week.

Benefits:

  • 100% Employer paid Health, Dental and Vision Insurance for you and your families

  • Life Insurance (Employer Paid)

  • Ability to participate in the companies 401k program (Matching)

  • Unlimited PTO policy with an enforced 2 week minimum

  • Equity Package

  • Work / Home Office Stipend

  • Global Entry

  • 16 Week Paid Parental Leave

  • Monthly Health and Wellness Stipend


Our Values:

  • Innovation: We are driven to break new ground. Every day presents an opportunity to challenge the status quo, think boldly, and deliver advanced solutions that transform the future of defense technology.

  • Integrity: We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency, accountability, and trust in all our actions and partnerships.

  • Mission-Driven: We are focused on achieving impactful outcomes that align with our core mission—protecting lives through innovation.

  • Forward-Leaning: We continuously seek out new opportunities and remain at the forefront of technological advancements. We embrace change and anticipate the challenges of tomorrow with confidence and creativity.

  • Ownership of All Tasks: At HavocAI, no problem is too complex or too trivial. We believe that greatness comes from tackling the hardest challenges, but also in handling the smallest, sometimes thankless, tasks with the same level of commitment and care.

  • Servant Leadership: We lead by serving others, whether it’s supporting our employees, partners, or the broader community. Empowering those around us is key to achieving long-term success and making a lasting impact.

HavocAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

usv-juro:ashbyhq:fa4018cc-206f-427f-9037.descriptionHtml:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/legal-engineer-us

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located in Massachusetts and have long-term working rights in the US.

  • Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked ca. $110,000-$120,000 + 20% bonus + equity at IC3 level in our

    Progression framework for someone based in the UK.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Sharen Gill, Director of Implementation
    → Sharen will be on maternity leave from mid-July. During this period, you'll report directly to Josephine Hanschke, Head of Customer Success.

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask talent@juro.com anything.

 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

 

...

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core Principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

 

On top of that, you've been part of a journey where:

  • You’ve autonomously onboarded multiple, multi-layer customers in parallel to some kind of service or platform.

  • You’ve worked to and consistently delivered on team targets.

  • You’re proactive in learning new technical or AI-oriented concepts and then apply them to your work with customers.

  • You’re “legal-curious,” i.e. interested in how contracts and law intersect with tech.

Bonus points if:

  • You've worked in a fast-growing AI or SaaS startup.

  • You've worked with Salesforce, Greenhouse, HubSpot, Workday or an API.

 

This job likely isn't for you if:

  • Presenting live kick-off, training sessions and webinars solo feels daunting — you’d rather stay behind the scenes than guide customers in real-time.

  • Running 25-plus parallel onboardings sounds overwhelming — you prefer deep focus on a single account at a time.

  • Figuring out new software, integrations and troubleshooting workflows isn’t your thing — you’d rather avoid the hands-on tehcnical work this role demands.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making legal contracts frictionless, collaborative and accessible.

Juro’s intelligent contract automation platform is on its way to de-throning desktop tools as the paradigm for collaborating on legal documentation around the world.

We’re doing that by rebuilding contracts from the ground-up around a browser-native experience, augmenting workflows with powerful AI and enabling all teams to conduct contracting jobs faster than ever before.

Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

 
 

GOT MORE QUESTIONS?

 

Check if they're answered on:

  • Our extended job description for this role: https://juro.notion.site/legal-engineer-us

  • Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook

  • Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site

 

There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach talent@juro.com for anything.

xange-bigblue:lever:c6ab5853-082f-4fdc-b.descriptionHtml:
📍 Berlin | Full-time | Fluent 🇩🇪& 🇬🇧
 
E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that.
We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.
 
Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 600+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 130+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 10 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener.
 
Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion. The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.
 
About the role 🚀
 
As a first Sales Outbound Expert in the German market, you will have the opportunity to shape this newly created role and establish your career path. This pioneering position allows you to lay the groundwork for our presence in Germany and play a crucial role in our growth strategy. 
 
🧑‍💻 Market insight
 
- Serve as the key observer and analyst for the German market, providing valuable insights into emerging trends, competitive landscape, and customer preferences.
- Collaborate closely with the Growth, Marketing, and Partnerships team to identify and research relevant sales targets within specific verticals and customer segments.
 
🕵️ Prospect engagement
 
- Conduct thorough research to understand the personal interests and professional needs of our target prospects. Our champions and decision-makers do not have any secret for you.
- Develop a deep understanding of prospect motivations, challenges, and buying behavior to tailor engagement strategies effectively.
 
🌟 Outbound prospecting campaigns
 
- Take charge of lead generation initiatives by designing and executing outbound prospecting campaigns. You’ll leverage all communication channels (email, LinkedIn, Instagram, phone calls, video messages) to generate leads on well-identified niche markets to achieve your monthly new revenue quota.
- Craft creative and personalized messaging to resonate with prospects across different channels, showcasing Bigblue's unique value proposition.
 
🎾 Relationship building
 
- Build and nurture strong relationships with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and resource.
- Organise or plan to attend events that your prospects will truly appreciate (Restaurants, sports events, sports sessions, music shows, etc)
- Act as a brand evangelist, continuously promoting Bigblue's success stories and nurturing connections to create a favorable environment for negotiations.

  • Excellent communication and copywriting skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented.
  • 💼 High impact role: Be at the center of our growth journey and help shape the team that will power Bigblue’s future.
  • 💙 Founders-led company with an innovative, caring culture.
  • 🚀 Fast-growing scale-up: Join a well-funded, early-stage company where your work will have immediate and visible results.
  • 🌍 International environment: Work across Paris, Madrid, London, and our European warehouse network.
  • 🖥️ MacBook or any setup you need — your choice of equipment to do your best work.

    Regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, origin, disability, age… At Bigblue, we create equal opportunities for all and make our culture as inclusive as possible. Because we believe that challenging assumptions and embracing diversity in experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger.
    Because what we value first and foremost are curiosity and growth-driven minds. So, regardless of who you are and how many “boxes” you tick on the job description, if you have the energy and passion to help shape Bigblue’s entrepreneurial adventure, APPLY.

yc-verifiable:lever:3b667e06-f6b9-43a9-a.descriptionHtml:
About Us: 
 
Verifiable is a provider credentialing and network monitoring platform, delivery industry-leading AI, API and Software solutions to help healthcare organizations optimize operations at enterprise scale. We are a top Salesforce partner, winning the 2024 Salesforce Partner Innovation Award, and also were named to Inc. 5000 2025, the most prestigious ranking of America's fastest-growing private companies. We work with leading healthcare organizations such as Humana Dental, Talkspace, Headway, Empower Pharmacy, and many others.
 
Verifiable is a fast-moving, early-stage team that values impact, ownership, and follow-through. Everyone here rolls up their sleeves, dives into ambiguity, and takes end-to-end responsibility for meaningful work. Priorities shift, problems aren’t always perfectly defined, and we move with urgency—so we look for people who are energized by hard problems, rapid learning, and stepping in wherever the team needs support.
 
We’re collaborative and human, but we keep a high bar. If you thrive in a scrappy, high-ownership environment where your work directly shapes the company’s trajectory, you’ll feel right at home here.

Verifiable is hiring an Enterprise Solutions Engineer to serve as the highest technical authority in our enterprise sales engagements. In this role, you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for our most complex, strategic deals — engaging directly with C-suite stakeholders, architecting multi-product solutions, and shaping both our go-to-market approach and product roadmap based on customer insights. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Implementation, Customer Success, and CS Engineering as a senior technical leader and force multiplier for the entire Solutions Engineering team.

  • Own end-to-end technical strategy on Verifiable's largest enterprise deals ($250K+ ARR), from first call through close and handoff to Implementation

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with C-suite stakeholders (CTO, CIO, COO) and drive technical decisions at the executive level

  • Lead advanced discovery sessions to uncover complex requirements and architect scalable, differentiated multi-product solutions

  • Scope and execute POCs and pilots — defining success criteria, aligning stakeholders, and managing technical risk

  • Own competitive positioning: RFP/RFI responses, battle cards, objection-handling guides, and win/loss documentation

  • Represent Verifiable at industry conferences and in technical communities (PreSales Collective, Salesforce Trailblazer Community)

  • Mentor and develop SEs across all levels; partner with leadership on go-to-market and product strategy

  • Maintain and continuously improve the enterprise demo environment, reference architecture library, and SE playbook
